decisions.reason: Having survived its first year with a dedicated product page in a growing market, A likely clears the firm's current aspiration level and is worth retaining within the core upholstery range.

B still looks somewhat less proven because of its lower prominence, but continued presence suggests results are not far enough below aspiration to justify withdrawal while the firm has some portfolio slack.
D fits existing design and material capabilities well, and after one more year on the market management would usually keep such an adjacent product unless performance clearly disappointed.

E remains the most niche and uncertain of the older launches, yet its continued survival implies performance is still close enough to aspiration that management would more likely monitor than terminate it.
F is newer and therefore still more uncertain, but its dedicated page and strong adjacency to the established offer make continued testing more likely than early withdrawal.
